core_obligations: Choose a presentation of the algebra and of its base change, and compare the primes above the given one in the two polynomial rings (proof lines 28537-28550).
Apply the local dimension formula on both sides and observe that the chain of equalities is the same, concluding that the two local dimensions agree (proof lines 28550-28572).
proof_roadmap: Compare the two presentations and their primes (proof lines 28536-28550).
Apply the dimension formula on both sides (proof lines 28550-28573).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the local dimension of a finite type algebra over a field at a point is unchanged after extending the base field and taking a prime above the given one (statement lines 28523-28534). The proof does not compare the two spectra directly: it writes down the corresponding presentations, compares the primes over the given one in the two polynomial rings, and applies the local dimension formula on both sides so that the same numerical identity appears twice (proof lines 28536-28573). Reducing both sides to the same formula is the step that makes the equality visible. H2.
